definitions.gloss: but; however; though (a slightly more emphatic variant of だけど)
definitions.explanation: A casual conjunction used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or qualifies what was just said. Functionally close to だけど, but with the extra も giving a slight feeling of "and yet…" or "…even so." Common in conversational and online writing; rare in formal documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。だけども、⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪|わる}くない→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: It's cheap. Still, the quality isn't bad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。だけども、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He's busy. But even so, he keeps in touch with me every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っていた→降る：00839_furu⟧。だけども、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予定通|よていどお}り→予定通り：15290_yoteidoori⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: It was raining. But even so, the game went ahead as scheduled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}して→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いかなかった。だけども、⟦{諦|あきら}め→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いれば→いる：00495_iru⟧、いつか⟦きっと→きっと：00860_kitto⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{信|しん}じている→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: I've tried many times and it hasn't worked out. Even so, I believe that if I keep going without giving up, the results will come someday.

notes:
だけども is a casual conjunction used to introduce a contrasting statement, very close in meaning and feel to だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧. The extra ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ lends it a slightly stronger "…and yet," "…even so" nuance, similar to the relationship between ⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧ and ⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧.

FORMALITY VARIANTS (most casual → most formal):
- だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧: casual
- だけども: casual, slightly more emphatic than だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧
- だ⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧: slightly more formal than だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧
- だ⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: full, formal form
- です⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: polite formal

USAGE:
- Most often appears at the start of a new sentence after a period ("…。だけども、…") rather than mid-clause.
- Can also trail at the end of a clause to soften the statement: 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧だけども、… ("…though, but…").
- だけども feels slightly more colloquial and warm than the longer だ⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧; speakers may prefer it when they want a softer, more chatty tone in casual speech or messaging.
- It is rarely seen in formal written contexts (essays, business documents); use ⟦しかし→しかし：00986_shikashi⟧ or だ⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ there instead.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧: but (more neutral/casual; the most common option in conversation)
- ⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: but (attaches to verb/adjective stems; slightly more polite)
- ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧: but (general-purpose casual conjunction; can begin a sentence)
- ⟦しかし→しかし：00986_shikashi⟧: however (more formal, written)
- ただし: however / provided that (introduces a qualification or condition)
